item.title: Davao City council eyes gratuity pay for job order and contractual workers before yearend
item.description: DAVAO CITY (MindaNews / 19 December) – The City Council of Davao is rushing the passage of a P187.324-million supplemental budget to ensure that the job order (JO) and contract of service (COS) workers of the local government receive their gratuity pay before yearend. item.title: Davao City Police Office receives 35 new vehicles from local government
item.description: DAVAO CITY (MindaNews / 20 December) – The Davao City Police Office (DCPO) received 32 brand new mobile patrol units and three vans worth P77 million from the local government. item.title: Freshwater crabs in Mindanao found to carry lung-fluke parasite
item.description: GENERAL SANTOS CITY (MindaNews / 20 December) — Freshwater crabs in Mindanao have been found to carry DNA of the lung-fluke parasite Paragonimus westermani, which can cause illness if crabs are eaten raw or undercooked, scientists reported.
